content:
andrea: CI red on PR #4823 — only failing job is integration-tests/node-e2e. I clicked rerun in GitHub but it restarts the whole workflow. Can we retrigger just that job or rebuild the image only? @kevin @ci-ops

ci-bot: saw run 987654321 for PR 4823. Workflow has 4 jobs: unit, lint, build-image, integration-tests. GitHub Actions UI offers ‘Re-run failed jobs’ (top-right) which should only rerun the failed ones, but it sometimes reruns the whole matrix if the job graph changed.

kevin: If you used the green dropdown -> Re-run failed jobs, GH usually reruns only failures. If it re-runs everything it's because the build-image job output changed or the run uses a dynamic matrix. Alternative: use the GH CLI to rerun the run id: `gh run rerun 987654321` (this reruns entire run).

kevin: For more targeted reruns we do one of two things depending on the platform:
- Buildkite: you can rebuild a single job from the job page -> Rebuild job.
- GitHub Actions: there isn't an official one-click to rerun a single job via CLI, but you can re-run failed jobs in the UI or re-trigger a specific workflow with a workflow_dispatch that scopes to only integration tests.

maya: if it's flaky, try reproducing locally first: `./dev/ci/run_integration.sh node-e2e --focus TestName` or run the specific test with `pytest -k "test_flow_xyz"` for python. Saves CI cycles.

andrea: The failing test looks like a timeout in the test harness after an image pull. I'd prefer to just rebuild the docker image and re-run integration-tests without redoing unit/lint. Any quick command?

kevin: We have a helper script to just rebuild the image and push to the CI cache: `./scripts/ci/rebuild-image.sh --image infra-node-e2e --push`. If you set `FORCE_CACHE_BUST=1` env it will force a new image. Then trigger a rerun of the integration job only by re-running failed jobs in GH UI (should pick up new image).

ci-ops: If the GH UI keeps re-running everything, I can manually re-trigger a workflow_dispatch for the integration pipeline with the new image tag. Ping me and I'll run it.

andrea: Thanks — I'll try `rebuild-image.sh` first. If that fails I'll ask @ci-ops to run the dispatch. Also adding a quick note: if you want to trigger a rebuild from the PR comment, we accept `@ci-bot rebuild-image infra-node-e2e` (bot command) for non-sensitive repos.

ci-bot: command recognized: `rebuild-image infra-node-e2e` queued by andrea. I'll post the image tag once push completes. :gear:

maya: small tip for future: when adding flaky tests to the PR description add the `[ci-flaky]` label so we can skip heavy suites on reruns. Helps keep queue short. :seedling:

ci-ops: I'll follow up with a short doc on the devwiki describing: rebuild-image script, GH UI rerun behavior, and the bot commands. Saving this thread into the infra runbook.

andrea: perfect — thanks all, will update once the rebuild finishes. :thumbsup:
